data.narrative:
Aventra is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by former US Army Cyber and USMA-trained operators, having raised $3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the same sector and stage—including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—alongside public benchmarks (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis, anchoring to the $3M total raised as a proxy for seed-stage value, applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to next round, yielding $8M. Peer-Median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, NODA AI at $125M Series A) produces a median of $400M, with a $125M–$1.0B range.

The two methods diverge substantially, reflecting stage-based conservatism versus peer-driven upside. Triangulation yields a median of $204M with a $6M low and $460M high. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around how strongly Aventra's operator-founder pedigree (Shift5 alumni, Army Cyber background) and mission alignment command Defense & Security investor appetite relative to peers. Key sensitivities include near-term customer traction, contract wins, and revenue milestones, which would inform whether the company converges toward the peer-median or stage-based floor.
